credentials.description: service ID — the user part of HTTP Basic auth, base64(SERVICE_ID:SECRET_TOKEN)
secret token — the password part of HTTP Basic auth

example_prompt: Add a contact to my NimbaSMS address book.

numero.description: Contact's phone number with country code (e.g. 224XXXXXXXXX).

groups.description: Names of the groups to add the contact to (optional). The groups must exist in your account.

numero.description: Phone number of the created contact.

groups.description: Groups the contact was added to.

numero.description: Validation errors on the 'numero' field (invalid format, duplicate).

groups.description: Validation errors on the 'groups' field (non-existent group).

gotchas: Without 'groups', the contact is added to the account's default contact list. Specifying a non-existent group returns a 400 error — use list_groups to retrieve valid names.
The 'numero' field must include the country code without the '+' (e.g. 224XXXXXXXXX), unlike send_verification, which expects E.164 format with '+'. An incorrect format returns a 400 error.
Creating a contact with an already existing number may return a duplicate error — check with list_contacts before bulk inserting.
open_questions: Sandbox: provider.json declares none and no gotcha documents a test environment — every call reaches production.
